transformations.edit: Adapted the inherent `[u8]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[u8]` parameter and named return for Verus; the executable target body remains the EscapeAscii constructor over the result of iterating the slice and applying EscapeByte.

Represented the source `self.iter().flat_map(EscapeByte)` call chain as `slice_iter(slice).flat_map(EscapeByte)` because Verus cannot use the inherent slice iterator internals directly; the helper bodies construct only source-backed iterator/adaptor state and preserve call order.

Extracted the EscapeByte marker and EscapeAscii private `inner` field shape; the harness uses a target-local FlatMapEscapeAscii view that records the source slice needed by the generated `slice_iterator_view` contract without assuming the target postcondition.
Instantiated the generated ASCII escape vocabulary from the frozen shared definitions of `ascii_lower_hex_digit`, `ascii_escape_byte`, and `ascii_escape_seq`.
Defined closed spec views for the harness-local iterator/adaptor state and revealed them only in ghost proof blocks; these annotations have no executable control-flow or data-flow effect.
